title.zh: 复盘：一项自选承诺，有清楚的改约办法
title.en: Review one chosen commitment and its revision

paragraphs.zh: 沿用时间不够的纸村落，写一项愿接的任务、完成条件和情况变化时的通知办法。其余点子仍可另选，不因接一块就默认包办全部。可以只改分工卡。复盘看约定是否可用、是否仍自愿，不以任务多难、是否隐形或有没有做完所有来证明荣誉、可靠或牺牲价值。
paragraphs.en: For the paper village with limited time, name one chosen task, its finish and a way to report changed conditions. Other ideas remain optional without accepting everything through one offer. Revise a task card only. Review a usable, voluntary agreement without proving honour, reliability or sacrificial worth through difficulty, invisibility or finishing everything.

title.en: Discuss choices through a peaceful paper village

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸村落时间不够，你愿接哪一项小任务，又怎样说明完成点与改约办法？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If the paper village had little time, which small task would you choose and how would you explain its finish and revision?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making models, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：趣味说法是否比平实说明更清楚
title.en: Review a playful phrase alongside a plain explanation

paragraphs.zh: 沿用显得过于宏大的虚构村名，写一个友好比喻和一句普通解释，请愿意的伙伴说哪句更好懂。好笑却分心时，可直接留下普通版。只起草也可以。复盘看描述是否贴合项目，不把机智当智力或说服分数；笑点不落在真人特征、体型或隐私上，也不要求别人发笑来认可你。
paragraphs.en: For the overgrand invented village name, draft a kind comparison and a plain explanation and ask a willing partner which is clearer. Keep the plain one if amusement distracts. Draft only. Review correspondence with the project without grading intelligence or persuasion through wit. Target no real person’s characteristics, body or private information and require no laughter as approval.

title.en: Discuss choices through a peaceful paper village

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果小村落的名字听起来像大工程，你会怎样各写一句趣味版和平实版，再比较是否更好懂？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a small village name sounded like a huge undertaking, how would you draft playful and plain versions and compare clarity?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making models, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：练一种手法，也能换方法或停下
title.en: Review a technique with room to change or stop

paragraphs.zh: 沿用陌生纸建筑折法，先确认说明、材料是否合适，再选一次真想试的小变化。可看示范、用图解、换手法或结束，不需独自反复才能算自主。可以只回看步骤。复盘描述哪里改变了，不评战斗、性别、身体或学习能力，也不把坚持次数当价值、纪律或自立的证据。
paragraphs.en: For the unfamiliar paper-building fold, check instructions and materials before choosing one variation you want. Watch, use a diagram, change methods or stop without solitary repetition as proof of autonomy. Review steps only. Describe a change without assessing combat, gender, physical or learning ability, or treating repetition as worth, discipline or self-reliance.

title.en: Discuss choices through a peaceful paper village

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸建筑的一道折法不熟悉，你想试哪一处小变化，又会何时请示范、换法或结束？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For an unfamiliar paper-building fold, which small variation would you try and when would you seek a demonstration, adapt or stop?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making models, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：介绍形式先问，不先猜访客
title.en: Review a format chosen by asking visitors

paragraphs.zh: 沿用模型展，准备两句总览和一个细节说明，让访客选先看哪种，也能只自己逛。不同选择不表示知识或地位高低，你也可说明能讲多久。可以只拟介绍卡。复盘看入口是否合实际问题，不用猜私下心情、恭维或不断迎合证明社交智力；呈现可变，自己的偏好不必一并改变。
paragraphs.en: For the model display, prepare a two-sentence overview and one detailed explanation, letting visitors choose or explore alone. Choices rank neither knowledge nor status, and you may limit explanation time. Draft an introduction card only. Review an entry suited to the actual question without guessing feelings, flattering or continual accommodation as social intelligence. Formats may change without changing your preferences.

title.en: Discuss choices through a peaceful paper village

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果访客有人想总览、有人想看细节，你会怎样给两种入口，并保留自己能介绍的范围？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If some visitors wanted an overview and others detail, how would you offer both entries while keeping your own explanation limits?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making models, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：想象大版本，不等于认领大任务
title.en: Review a larger imagined version without assigning work

paragraphs.zh: 沿用纸村落空角，画一个完整街区想象和一个几分钟可构思的小版本，先问大家想不想继续，再谈自愿任务。两版都可只留纸上，不需采购或说服所有人。复盘看想象是否受欢迎、承诺是否另行约清，不以宏大评领导或命运，也不让愿景超过他人的拒绝与时间上限。
paragraphs.en: For the village’s empty corner, sketch a whole district and a version taking minutes to imagine. Ask whether people want to continue before voluntary tasks. Both may stay drawings without purchases or persuasion. Review a welcomed possibility and separately agreed commitments without grandeur as leadership or destiny, or placing a vision above refusal and time limits.

title.en: Discuss choices through a peaceful paper village

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸村落空角能变一个大街区，你会怎样同时呈现大想象和小版本，却不自动给人派任务？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If an empty paper-village corner could become a district, how would you present a large idea and small version without assigning work?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making models, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：新信息、修改与未定处分别说明
title.en: Review new information, revision and uncertainty separately

paragraphs.zh: 沿用首布局不再合适，写清新添作品改变了什么，再只改一处，保留仍没决定的部分。无需隐藏首稿、表演羞耻或一次推翻全部。可以只画前后两版。复盘看小改是否回应具体信息，不把改爱好计划称为救赎、道德成长或修复无关伤害，也不据结果判断现实问责与可信度。
paragraphs.en: For the first layout no longer fitting, state what new pieces changed, revise one part and retain what remains undecided. Hide no draft and require neither shame nor a total restart. Sketch before and after only. Review a response to specific information without calling a hobby revision redemption, moral growth or repair of unrelated harm, or assessing accountability and trust through a result.

title.en: Discuss choices through a peaceful paper village

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果新增作品让首布局不合适，你会先说明哪条新信息，再只修改哪里、保留什么未定处？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If new pieces made the first layout unsuitable, which information would you name, what would you revise and what would remain undecided?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making models, attending or disclosing experiences.
